aliases: 4CH AI Multi-sensor Camera with Lumeo Analytics

storage.notes: 2 microSD/SDHC/SDXC slots (512GB each, 1TB total) plus 256GB SSD on the NVIDIA carrier board.

features: 4-channel 8MP multi-directional, PTRZ remote lens adjustment (pan 0-360 / tilt 30-90 / rotate 0-90)
AI object detection: person, face, vehicle, license plate; BestShot; virtual line/area analytics
NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 8GB carrier board
Audio and extra alarm I/O via optional SPM-4210 I/O box
Lumeo Analytics: 4x Lumeo AI Platform Enterprise licenses, pre-built analytics library, custom analytics builder
Lumeo cloud-based management, remote live view, dashboards (30-day retention)
15fps per channel with AI on, 20fps with AI off (MJPEG max 5fps at 8MP)

frigate.notes: Hanwha profiles: profile1=MJPEG, profile2=main, profile3=sub (default Wisenet profile layout); not yet verified on this model.

release_notes: Specs per official Hanwha Vision datasheet (DataSheet_PNM-C32084RQZ-8XE256G-LU_260101_EN.pdf). Lumeo-analytics bundle of the PNM-C32084RQZ-8XE256G hardware, kept as a separate SKU. B/W min. illumination is 0 lux (IR LED on) and is not recorded. Power consumption is the max for the included Orin NX 8GB module (66W; 71W with Orin NX 16GB).
